title: Approximating the Euclidean Ball by Polytopes: Surprising Rates in High Dimensions
abstract: arXiv:2610.34651v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We provide sharp estimates on the number of vertices needed to approximate the Euclidean unit ball $B_d\subset\mathbb R^d$ with relative symmetric-difference volume error at most $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$. We show that the minimum vertex budget $N_\varepsilon(d)$ satisfies $$\log N_\varepsilon(d)\asymp d\log\left(1+\frac1{\varepsilon\sqrt d}\right).$$ In particular, $\exp(O(\sqrt d/\varepsilon))$ vertices suffice for every $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$ and all sufficiently large $d$. We also prove that achieving a fixed error $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$ requires at least $\Omega\bigl((\tfrac{1+\varepsilon}{2\sqrt\varepsilon})^{d-1}\bigr)$ facets, an exponential number in $d$. We extend our vertex approximation result to Gaussian symmetric-difference error, and give a positive answer to the question of De, Nadimpalli, and Servedio about subexponential vertex complexity for approximating Euclidean balls. translated_title: 用多面体逼近欧氏球：高维中的惊人速率
translated_abstract: 我们给出了用相对对称差体积误差至多 ε∈(0,1) 来逼近欧氏单位球 B_d⊂R^d 所需顶点数的精确估计。我们证明最小顶点预算 N_ε(d) 满足 log N_ε(d) ≍ d log(1 + 1/(ε√d))。特别地，对每个 ε∈(0,1) 以及所有充分大的 d，exp(O(√d/ε)) 个顶点即可足够。我们还证明了达到固定误差 ε∈(0,1) 至少需要 Ω(((1+ε)/(2√ε))^(d-1)) 个面，这是关于 d 的指数级数量。我们将顶点逼近结果推广到高斯对称差误差的情形，并对 De、Nadimpalli 和 Servedio 提出的关于逼近欧氏球的次指数顶点复杂性问题给出了肯定答案。我们还否证了一个 Macbeath 型的极值性原理。
tldr: 本文给出了用多面体逼近高维欧氏球所需顶点数的精确估计，证明仅需次指数级数量的顶点 exp(O(√d/ε)) 即可，但达到固定误差却需要指数级数量的面，并肯定回答了 De 等人关于次指数顶点复杂性的公开问题。
en_tdlr: This paper provides sharp estimates for the number of vertices needed to approximate the high-dimensional Euclidean ball by polytopes, showing that subexponentially many vertices exp(O(√d/ε)) suffice while fixed error requires exponentially many facets, and affirmatively answering the open question of De et al. on subexponential vertex complexity.
